title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists an atmospheric scale height of 8.5 km
summary: The fact sheet lists an atmospheric scale height of 8.5 kilometers.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists the atmospheric scale height as 8.5 kilometers, next to a surface density of 1.217 kilograms per cubic meter. This card records the scale height. It does not derive the number from temperature and molecular weight.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
